verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an entitlements/Features model attached to plans, including a UI to manage customer privileges and AI-assisted entitlement creation, and separately documents a general REST API and Node.js SDK. However, no evidence explicitly shows an API/SDK endpoint or method for checking a customer's entitlements at runtime. missing for 10: explicit entitlements-check API endpoint or SDK method, code sample showing runtime lookup, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
